dedupe_keys.name: energy consumption data of the gridflex heeten project

description: This data set records minute-by-minute electricity consumption and gas use of 77 households in the village of Heeten in the Netherlands from August 2018 to August 2020. It was collected in the GridFlex Heeten project as part of Victor Reijnders' doctoral research and published on 4TU.ResearchData in 2021 by Victor Reijnders, Marco Gerards and Johann Hurink. All participating households agreed that their anonymous data could be used in further research, with collection following a privacy-by-design approach. Each household has electricity consumption and gas usage at one-minute resolution, giving two full years of high resolution demand for a single village, including two heating seasons. Coverage is one village. Files are downloadable from 4TU.ResearchData under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the non-commercial licence limits reuse, 77 households in one village are not representative of national demand, and the page read on the day gives no detail of appliance data or household characteristics. Simulation uses are low-voltage grid planning, demand-side flexibility and heat electrification studies at neighbourhood scale. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
